customer.title: Customer payments
customer.description: Money received from customers. Payments are never deleted; a mistake is voided with a reason.
customer.noOpenOrders: This customer has no unpaid orders; the payment goes on account.
customer.voidBody: The payment of {{amount}} from {{name}} stays on record but no longer counts toward the balance. This can't be undone.

supplier.title: Supplier payments
supplier.description: Money paid to suppliers. Payments are never deleted; a mistake is voided with a reason.
supplier.noOpenOrders: No received orders from this supplier are waiting for payment; the payment goes on account.
supplier.voidBody: The payment of {{amount}} to {{name}} stays on record but no longer counts toward what you owe. This can't be undone.

form.title: Record a payment
form.orderHint: Optional. Leave it on account to reduce the overall balance.
form.referenceHint: Optional, e.g. a receipt, transfer or cheque number.

validation.amount: Enter an amount above zero (up to 2 decimals).
validation.exceeds: This is more than the {{amount}} outstanding on the order.
validation.date: Choose a date that isn't in the future.
